title: Privacy Policy
body:
Privacy Policy explains how Fulvio Correa Plastic Surgery collects, uses, stores, and protects information submitted through our website, forms, WhatsApp, SMS, and related communication channels.

## 1. Who We Are

 Fulvio Correa Plastic Surgery provides plastic surgery information, patient guidance, consultation coordination, and medical care in Cartagena de Indias, Colombia.

## 2. Information We Collect

- Name and contact information

- Phone number and email address

- Procedure interests and preferences

- Travel and consultation information

- Messages submitted through forms, WhatsApp, SMS, or chat widgets

## 3. How We Use Your Information

- Respond to inquiries and requests

- Coordinate consultations and procedures

- Provide information regarding services

- Send SMS and WhatsApp communications related to your inquiry

- Improve patient experience and website functionality

## 4. SMS & WhatsApp Communications

 By submitting your information through our forms or communication channels, you consent to receive conversational and informational messages from Fulvio Correa Plastic Surgery.

 Message frequency may vary. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to unsubscribe or HELP for assistance.

 SMS consent is not shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing purposes.

## 5. Data Protection

 We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.

## 6. Contact

 If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal information, please contact our team directly through our official communication channels.
